# dagsterplus_users (Data Source)

Lists all Dagster+ organization members.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dagsterplus_users" "all" {}

output "users" {
  value = data.dagsterplus_users.all.users
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email_regex` (String) Regex filter to select users based on email address. Regex matching is done using Go's regexp package.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for this data source.
- `users` (Attributes List) Users in the organization, optionally filtered by email_regex. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The email address of the user.
- `id` (String) The user ID assigned by Dagster+.
- `is_scim_provisioned` (Boolean) Whether this user was provisioned through SCIM.
- `name` (String) The display name of the user.
- `picture` (String) URL to the user's profile picture.
- `role` (String) The organization-level role: VIEWER, EDITOR, ADMIN, or OWNER.
